lines.en: Seaweed withers under me.

lines.zh: 回头看，会想起自己的名字。
lines.en: Look back and you'll recall your name.

lines.zh: 前面有血味，顺着水来的。
lines.en: Blood ahead, carried by the water.

lines.zh: 咸味从礁缝里冒出来，像家。
lines.en: Salt seeps from the reef cracks, like home.
Sculk rewrote the deep-sea paths.

lines.zh: 神殿里没人等我，只有菌。
lines.en: No one waits at the temple but the sculk.

lines.zh: 这条水道，我巡过一百年。
lines.en: I've patrolled this channel a hundred years.
Someone paddles behind me. Who?
One ray of light and I shrink into the sculk.
Don't rush. Nothing is fast in water.
That rattle in my shell is sculk growing.
Sea sand is packed in my fin joints.
No breathing needed. Only bubbles.

lines.zh: 太阳照到海底，只剩一点绿。
lines.en: Sunlight reaching the seabed is only a hint of green.

lines.zh: 守卫者的眼睛，现在只剩一层绿。
lines.en: My guardian eye is only green now.
Something crawls in the reef crack.
Who lit a lamp on the surface?

lines.zh: 名字忘了，只记得守着门。
lines.en: I forgot my name. I remember guarding the gate.

lines.zh: 这具身体里全是幽匿在响。
lines.en: Sculk rattles all through this body.
Eight points of health, and I still guard the gate.
Something rattles in my shell. The sculk is chewing.
So still I can hear the sculk growing.

lines.zh: 我的刺，是幽匿磨出来的。
lines.en: Sculk ground my spines sharp.
I saw you at the temple gate.
A school of fish circles behind you.

lines.zh: 你认识我吗？我应该认识你。
lines.en: Do I know you? I should know you.

lines.zh: 你的血味，顺着水飘过来。
lines.en: Your blood drifts to me through the water.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在海底，很好看。
lines.en: Your shadow on the seabed is lovely.
A living one, still warm.
Will you stay down here with me?

lines.zh: 八点血的我，也守着这片。
lines.en: Eight health, and I still guard this ground.
Stop swimming. I know these waters better.
Two spines snapped. I can still swim.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，我的壳在响。
lines.en: Strong arm. My shell is ringing.
Eight health points, and I still hold.

lines.zh: 我的符文一响，你就该走。
lines.en: When my rune rings, you should leave.
Sculk has bitten through my bones.
I've only eight left. Leave some.
Not that. It's a fresh split.

lines.zh: 活着挨这一下，会叫出声。
lines.en: Alive, this blow would make me cry out.
Eight health, and the shell hasn't split through.

lines.zh: 我守着这片幽匿，不让路。
lines.en: I guard this sculk and will not move.
Rotten flesh sunk in the seabed smells best.

lines.zh: 幽匿的光，照不进我的肚子。
lines.en: Sculk light does not reach my belly.
Don't take it. Let me look once more.

lines.zh: 五点的攻击，也够刺穿你。
lines.en: Five points of damage is enough to pierce you.

lines.zh: 手离远点，我的刺不认人。
lines.en: Keep your hand away. My spines know no friends.
Prismarine tang. I like it.
Can this seaweed be eaten? Probably.

lines.zh: 我只有八点生命，但守得最久。
lines.en: Eight health, but I hold the longest.

lines.zh: 深海的声音，我用来定位。
lines.en: I echolocate with deep-sea sound.

lines.zh: 血味从你的纱布里透出来。
lines.en: Blood scent leaks through your bandage.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，撞得我刺发抖。
lines.en: Your heartbeat makes my spines tremble.
Watch your feet. Don't kick my spines.
Eight points of health, and I still guard.
I turn sideways, fins against the reef.

lines.zh: 你骨头硬，撞得我刺发麻。
lines.en: Hard bones. The bump numbs my spines.
What's the hurry? The seafloor road is long.
Move. Seaweed hangs off me.
Bump me? My spines won't be polite.

lines.zh: 我学了句道歉，说得像气泡。
lines.en: I learned an apology. It comes out like bubbles.
One bump and I crumble — I know.
My heart stopped. My gills still move.
A ring won't fit over my fin.
The living swim away. I keep the reef.

lines.zh: 别碰我，幽匿会爬上你的手。
lines.en: Don't touch — sculk climbs onto hands.

lines.zh: 我只有八点血，也守着门。
lines.en: Eight points of health, and I still guard the gate.

lines.zh: 我在礁石下给你留了半穴。
lines.en: I saved you half a hollow under the reef.

lines.zh: 八点血，我也守着这一块。
lines.en: Eight health, and I still guard this patch.
This shell won't hatch any little ones.

lines.zh: 就这样并排游着，别说话。
lines.en: Let's swim side by side and say nothing.
Don't look. I'm missing an eye.
I gathered shells like this when alive.

lines.zh: 这堆东西，我要搬回巢里。
lines.en: I will carry this pile back to the nest.
Whatever sinks to the seabed is mine.
Hold it. Drop it and it sinks into the sculk.

lines.zh: 这根骨头，我收进幽匿里。
lines.en: I take this bone into the sculk.

lines.zh: 没有口袋，只能含在嘴里。
lines.en: No pockets. I hold it in my mouth.
This rune isn't from the temple.
Not a bone. A sunken boat's oar.
Carry it back and bury it in sculk.
Eight points of health, don't underestimate me.

lines.zh: 让你久等了，幽匿守卫在此。
lines.en: Sorry to keep you; the sculk guardian is here.
You smell fresh, and I like it.
Swim. I guard the exit.
Eight health is enough to hold this gap.
Catching you is only a matter of time.

lines.zh: 我这点血，够我咬你一口。
lines.en: This little health is enough for one bite.
My sculk spines rise toward you.
The water rippled, and I found you.
Take our time. There's no daylight down here.
You. That shadow.
Don't fear. One spine and it's done.
Eight points, and I still block you.
Whoever moves a fin tastes the spine first.

lines.zh: 找了整片海，终于堵到你。
lines.en: A whole sea of searching, and I've cornered you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，我要挂在刺上。
lines.en: Your eye goes on my spine.
Stop swimming. Dead reef ahead.
My spikes are shorter than the sea ones.
Stop. Let's talk through the water.
The sculk on the seabed keeps growing.
Chased you from the temple to this shoal.
Slow down. You can't see the path in water.
In the water, I never tire.

lines.zh: 慢慢游，暗流会把你卷走。
lines.en: Swim slowly. The undercurrent will take you.
The current already favors me.
A reef wall ahead, no gap.
The ground you crossed reeks of you.
The more you swim, the more my spines itch.
I've counted every reef stone.
You can't outswim my fins.

lines.zh: 别躲进光柱，我在暗处等。
lines.en: Don't hide in the light shaft. I wait in the dark.

lines.zh: 就差一截，我的刺够得着。
lines.en: One length away. My spines can reach.
My eyes are sculk green.
When the shadow on the seabed moves, I move.

lines.zh: 我只有八点血，可我不怕水。
lines.en: Eight points only, and water cannot drown me.

lines.zh: 水声一响，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: One splash, and I know where you are.
A torn fin, and I follow the current after you.
I swim slow, but I follow close.
My spine grazed your leg. A shame.
In water, my fin swings half a beat late.

lines.zh: 力气不大，可这一下够用。
lines.en: Little strength, but enough for this.
Fall gently. Don't crush the sculk bed.
The water stirred, and my spine went wide.
The light I cast gives no warmth.

lines.zh: 这一下，是第八只眼睛教的。
lines.en: That one I learned from my eighth eye.
Bone on bone. Listen.
Take this thrust, thick with sea brine.

lines.zh: 别叫，声音在水里传得远。
lines.en: Don't scream. Sound carries far in water.

lines.zh: 这身刺，只剩守门和扎人。
lines.en: These spines only guard gates and pierce now.
Move. This channel is mine.

lines.zh: 我只剩八点血，也别小看。
lines.en: Only eight health left, and still do not blink.
This thrust carries the rust of the seabed.
See? Eight health, and I can still sting.
For that blow — I'm sorry.
No lamps. The seabed is dark already.
I guard this little patch of growth.
Sand underfoot. Temple sand.

lines.zh: 神殿塌了一半，菌长满了。
lines.en: Half the temple collapsed. Sculk fills it.
Eight points is enough to hold this door.

lines.zh: 鳍撑住礁石，我站起来了。
lines.en: Fins braced on the reef, I rise.

lines.zh: 守护者这一身刺，从幽匿里长出来。
lines.en: These spines of mine grew out of the sculk.
Too bright. My single eye aches.

lines.zh: 从菌床底下，我又游回来。
lines.en: From beneath the sculk bed, I swim back.
These spines again, eight health left.

lines.zh: 醒来先巡一圈礁，再找吃的。
lines.en: First I circle the reef, then I hunt.
In the sculk web, which way do I go?
The monument altar. I'm back.

lines.zh: 我先动一根手指，好，还能动。
lines.en: One finger first. Good, it still moves.

lines.zh: 火在水里也烧，幽匿怕火。
lines.en: Fire burns even in water. Sculk fears it.
Two of my spines snapped off.
I can move underwater — it just hurts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把海底的菌床掀了。
lines.en: The blast tore up the seabed sculk.

lines.zh: 暗处的箭，扎进我的幽匿里。
lines.en: An arrow from the dark, into my sculk.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进壳缝，又痒又疼。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my shell cracks, itching and burning.

lines.zh: 肚子空得能听见海水回声。
lines.en: My belly's so empty the seawater echoes in it.
Lightning runs down through the water. I go numb.
No water, and still I keep sinking.
